findings.description: The core list names Yiorgos Makris (Professor) and the emeritus list separately names Stojan Radic (Professor Emeritus). Both link to the same generic Jacobs faculty_bios index page, so roster_mode="union" deduplicated 117 named directory rows (core 61, affiliated 25, emeritus 31) to 116 records. Makris is classified from his named core row; Radic has no separate required record and needs its own identity in any roster correction (ECE catalog lists both without further qualification; the emeritus list marks Radic Professor Emeritus).

catalog.ucsd.edu/faculty/ECE.html retains historical or departed names absent from the authoritative current ece.ucsd.edu/people/faculty/affiliated roster, including Todd Coleman, Ying S. Meng, Ryan Orosco, Gustaf Arrhenius, Pankaj Das and Nasser Peyghambarian, plus older emeriti (Robert Lugannani, M. Lea Rudee). The current ECE rosters are treated as authoritative; none of these names is counted. All four primary list pages and the catalog were re-fetched live on 2026-11-23 and are byte-identical to the pinned captures.

The legacy profile URLs for Curt Schurgers (Calit2) and Wei Xiong (Chemistry) are covered by the brief profile_url_aliases; the pinned Jacobs/UCSD Profiles aliases were used (Schurgers: Teaching Professor; Xiong: Professor, Chemistry and Biochemistry).

Sheng Xu: Jacobs profile reads "Adjunct Professor, NENG; Faculty-Affiliate, BENG; Faculty-Affiliate, ECE", so the specific adjunct title governs and he is excluded/adjunct. The older catalog line ("Assistant Professor, NanoEngineering, Bioengineering") is generic and does not override it.

John Proakis: ECE affiliated roster lists him as Affiliate Faculty from Calit2; his Jacobs profile says Faculty-Affiliate, ECE, with the title Professor Emeritus at Northeastern and no UCSD professorial rank, so he is excluded/affiliate (the retired/emeritus status would also exclude him).

Imanuel Lerman: the ECE affiliated roster shows only "Affiliate Faculty from the Department of Anesthesiology" and the providers page shows no rank. The ECE catalog gives Associate Clinical Professor, Anesthesiology. Classified included/affiliate_professor because a professor is officially listed by the ECE department as affiliate faculty; if the clinical-series title is judged non-professorial for this policy the decision becomes excluded/affiliate.

Mohan Trivedi appears on the official ECE Emeritus Faculty list (title "Distinguished Professor") and the catalog marks him Emeritus, while the undated Jacobs profile reads "Professor, ECE"; classified emeritus per the specific official designation.
